title: Research: prove even-subset R floor 82 among X=6 at seven queries (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and scope

In the five-source common-B mutable-source alphabet of [#1898](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1898), every restored straight-line word with **exactly seven queries** and even-subset connector-state readout needs **at least 82 readouts**. Among words with **`X = 6`**, that floor is sharp: the path-lowered champion `(0,1,2,6,12,24,16,0)` attains `7 Q / 82 R / 6 X` (abstract tariff **442** at `(b,a,x)=(38,2,2)`).

| Covering walk class | Distinct nonzero labels | Attainable even-subset R |
|---|---:|---|
| Hamilton (distinct slots) | 6 | **{82, 88}** |
| One repeated vertex (GL basis census) | 5 spanning | **{96}** |
| Rank `< 5` label sets | ≤4 independent | none (image ≤16) |

This answers open question 1 of [#2643](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2643): min `R` among restored seven-query words with `X = 6` is **exactly 82**. In particular `R ≤ 78` is impossible, so tariff `38·7 + 2R + 2·6` cannot undercut six-query endpoint **436** by lowering `R` at `X = 6`. Repeated prefixes cannot beat 82 (only add `R = 96`).

**Scoped obstruction with sharp attainment; no new kappa.** Leave-alone through [#2677](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2677) (including [#2643](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2643), [#2593](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2593)) was not reopened.

## Result

Package: `research/seven-query-r-floor/`.
Tip: `0e5f24d033eba7a36e6fc990d7263dc4c2ee9183`.

Exact: `min_R_among_X=6` is **82** sharp; repeat layer `R=96`; tariff floor **442**.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/seven-query-r-floor/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/seven-query-r-floor/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/seven-query-r-floor/independent.py
python3.12 -I -B research/seven-query-r-floor/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/seven-query-r-floor
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_SEVEN_QUERY_R_FLOOR Q=7 min_R_among_X=6 is 82 sharp repeat_layer_R=96 answers_7qxor_oq1 tariff_floor=442 no_new_kappa
PASS_INDEPENDENT_SEVEN_QUERY_R_FLOOR min_R=82 ... tariff=442 answers_7qxor_oq1
PASS_SEVEN_QUERY_R_FLOOR_PACKAGE_TESTS groups=6
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/seven-query-r-floor outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()`; `-O` also passes.

## Overlap and credit

Closest priors: [#2643](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2643) (`X≥6` at Q=7; OQ1), [#2677](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2677) (path-lowered distinct-slot spectrum), [#1898](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1898). Freestanding; no competing open PR on this repeated-prefix R floor at refresh.
